title: Product-first: manuscripts are outputs, not the project's memory
old_model: Organize the project primarily around a paper draft and retrofit the implementation to match manuscript structure.
observed_limitations: A manuscript becomes stale as Product and Knowledge evolve.
A polished draft can hide missing source provenance, unvalidated claims or absent negative findings.
The project loses rationale that has not yet been written into the manuscript.
current_model: Prioritize reliable and auditable Product/Knowledge capability; preserve research events, claims, theory evolution and evidence mappings separately; synthesize paper sections from accepted evidence packs.
rationale: Research claims should emerge from what the project can actually demonstrate, while a manuscript remains a versioned communication artifact.
consequences: The current manuscript is classified as a draft snapshot.
Claim maturity is tracked independently from prose maturity.
Evidence packs must include limits and wording ceilings.
what_remains_valid: The existing Paper 1 outline and manuscript remain useful working artifacts.
The first paper remains bounded to formalization and internal validation.
boundaries: This is project strategy, not a scientific finding about predictive accuracy.
Sidecar records do not replace main repository truth.
